summary: One item of a tree. It may hold a group of items of its own.

value.description: What the tree's value becomes when this item is selected. Without it, the item's label text.

expanded.description: The item's group shows. Only an item with a group has it.

disabled.description: It cannot be chosen or focused.

root.note: Stacks its label and its group.

label.note: The item's own row: the author marks it with data-part="label". It takes the paint of hover, focus and selected.

group.note: The items inside this one: the author marks it with data-part="group". It shows while the item is expanded, and is indented by ui-geometry's tree indent.

notYet: A chevron that shows whether an item is open: the author writes an icon in the label.
